notes.title: Welcome to our Steam Community Hub!
notes.notes:
[b]Hey guys! [/b]

Thank you for following our Community Hub. We will make sure that you guys will get as much information on our game here! Don't hesitate to ask questions and post some content. 

We are planning the launch of the PC & Mac OS version of Dominus on Steam in Winter 2020.
Also, we'll have beta testing in the next month or so and will be sending out codes!
 
Don’t forget to visit our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1333480/Dominus__Multiplayer_Sim_Turn_Based_Strategy/]Steam page[/url] and wishlist us so You don’t miss out on any updates!
